notes: Broad static vendor-map density passed the source-level bars in old/mid/late at 207/221/212 issuer-weeks, 24/28/29 tickers, and top1 13.53/10.86/12.26 percent. parameters.single_causal_variable: NVD Initial Analysis issuer-week cluster >=3 activates a next-session five-trading-session long-entry exclusion for that issuer

post_run_reflection.forbidden_near_neighbor_retry: Do not retune the same NVD Initial Analysis cluster threshold, five-session exclusion length, issuer subset, response function, or admission cutoff. Dense publication clusters already removed profitable entries in two clean windows, and repairing the date-only daily parity gap alone is measurement work rather than new alpha evidence.
post_run_reflection.new_evidence_required: Reopen only for a genuinely different vulnerability-risk source or signal tied to exploitability or issuer financial materiality, or after at least 30 PIT-correct settled forward issuer events across at least 10 tickers have replacement values. A new threshold, weighting, or exclusion horizon is insufficient.
